description: Add an issue type of this project's own — e.g. 'Показ' — or rename one it already has. Keyed by name. The shared types (Epic, Story, Task, Bug, Sub-task, Client) are every project's and cannot be renamed here. Another project never sees this type. Project lead or admin only.

name.description: The type's name. An own type of this project with this name is renamed (with newName) rather than duplicated.

newName.description: Rename the type to this. Leave out to add or keep it.

subtask.description: When adding: true for a sub-task type, whose issues hang off a parent. Cannot be changed afterwards.

name: set_project_issue_type
